Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon’ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
Mr. Rajesh Joshi, learned counsel holding brief 
of Mr. Deep Prakash Bhatt, learned counsel for the 
appellant.
2. Mr. Rakesh Negi, learned Brief Holder for the 
State. 
3. This appeal has been preferred by the appellant 
against the impugned judgment and order dated 
20.07.2024 passed by Special Judge (N.D.P.S.
Act)/District & Sessions Judge, District Champawat 
in S.S.T. No.31/2021, whereby appellant has been 
convicted for the offence punishable under Section 
20(b)(ii)(C) of N.D.P.S. Act and sentenced to 
undergo 12 years’ R.I. along with fine of Rs. 
1,00,000/-. 
4. As per the office report, appeal is within time.
5. Admit the appeal.
6. T.C.R. be summoned. 
7. The Registry is directed to prepare paper book 
after receiving the T.C.R. and supply the same to the 
learned counsel for the parties on their request, as per 
Rules.
8. List the matter on 18.11.2024.
9. Meanwhile, State counsel may file objection to 
the bail application.
(Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 
 17.09.2024
BS/Akash
